title: Search-Eval Catalog Capture
description: The retailer's own taxonomy: category nodes, the facet values each exposes, and the SKUs behind them. Produced by the catalog-capture stage; consumed by category-recall-dataset to build answer keys, and by every stage that needs the catalog guardrail (L04).

facet_provenance.description: L05 circularity guard. If facets were assigned by a text classifier over product titles and search indexes those same titles, recall measures the classifier agreeing with itself. Answer keys built on 'text_classifier' or 'unknown' provenance must be marked low confidence.

singular.description: Node name in the form a shopper types it ('chair' not 'Chairs'). Used to synthesize queries.

facets.description: Filter rails per node. A facet value plus its node is a query with a known answer.

cross_cutting.description: True when the facet spans sibling nodes (closure: slip-on covers loafers, mules, slides). L07 - these produce node_attr relations, never node equivalences.

null_rate.description: Share of the node's SKUs with no value for this facet. L02 - a hollow key inverts the precision reading. Above 0.30 the facet must not produce answer keys.

sibling_blocklist.description: L06. Node pairs sharing a parent, emitted so no downstream stage can propose them as synonyms (loafers/oxfords).

limitations.description: What could not be captured and why. Enterprise stores usually expose no catalog API; say so rather than implying full coverage.
